May be used once by a [[player]] to change any [[dice|roll]] of 4, 5 or 6 to an 8.
==Trivia==
* The title of this [[card types|card]] appears to be a play on words for 'Internet date'

{{Quest Card
| name = Zero Protection
| image = 1090 - Zero Protection-thumbnail
| game = Quest
| cardid = 1090
| type = Special
| background = Vertical Gradient
| aggressive = No
| deck = Fantastic

}}
The [[player]] with this [[card types|card]] saved may [[Immediately (Concept)|immediately]] replace any Zero Value small card with a new one from the supply (if any exist).
==Interactions==
* This card shows the [[Yellow Ball with the Red Stripe]]
[[Category:Yellow Ball with the Red Stripe]]

{{Quest Card
| name = Bad Hare Day
| image = 1091 - Bad Hare Day-thumbnail
| game = Quest
| cardid = 1091
| type = Very Special
| background = Diagonal Gradient
| aggressive = Yes
| deck = Fantastic
| prev = [[Zero Protection]]
| next = [[Out Of Harm's Way]]
}}
May be used once by a [[player]] to force the first player to kill a [[Bunny]] to return all of his [[Carrot|Carrots]] to [[Kaballa's Market]]. Must be used during the turn in which the first bunny was killed!

==Trivia==
*The title of this card is a play on the expression 'Bad hair day' (ie, a day when one's hair seems unmanageable and unattractive).

{{Quest Card|aggressive = Yes|type = Run|deck = Caramel Swirl|game = Quest|name = Island Vote|image = 1124 - Island Vote-thumbnail|cardid = 1124|background = Horizontal Gradient|prev = [[Goldistocks]]|next = [[Johnny Wishbone]]}}
May be used once by all players to vote on which bunny in The [[Bunny Circle]] should be discarded. If a majority agree then the bunny voted is discarded. Voting starts with the player and proceeds clockwise.
==Trivia==
* '''Island Vote''' uses artwork similar to [[Leaky Tiki Torch]].

{{Quest Card|aggressive = No|type = Run|deck = Caramel Swirl|game = Quest|name = Johnny Wishbone|image = 1125 - Johnny Wishbone-thumbnail|cardid = 1125|background = Horizontal Gradient|prev = [[Island Vote]]|next = [[Lone Wolf]] (Bunny Modifier)}}
May be used once by a [[player]] to guess the month in which each of his [[opponent|opponents]] was born and to take one [[Carrot]] from any [[Kaballa's Market]] for each correct guess.
==Trivia==
* '''Johnny Wishbone''' parodies the movie ''Beverly Hills Cop II'', where Eddie Murphy acts as a psychic (Johnny Wishbone) and "guesses" people's names.

{{Quest Card|aggressive = Yes|type = Run|deck = Caramel Swirl|game = Quest|name = Yellow-Bellied Sapsucker|image = 1134 - Yellow-Bellied Sapsucker-thumbnail|cardid = 1134|background = Horizontal Gradient|prev = [[Where The Buffalo Roam]]|next = [[Cow By A River]]}}
May be used once by a player to roll the die and to take a number of [[Water]] and [[Milk]] units equal to the number rolled from the discard piles. The units may be all Water, all Milk or a combination of both that total the number rolled.

==Trivia==
* '''Yellow-Bellied Sapsucker''' parodies a term used by Ed Norton on the classic TV show ''The Honeymooners''.<ref>[https://www.facebook.com/1246671419/videos/10220192468142365/Facebook The Bunny Circle post from Stel Tsolakides on 2019-07-01 from video at 11:35]</ref>
==References==
<references />

{{Quest Card|aggressive = No|type = Special|deck = Caramel Swirl|game = Quest|name = Protein Resequencer|image = 1138 - Protein Resequencer-thumbnail|cardid = 1138|background = Vertical Gradient|prev = [[Marvin Gardens]]|next = [[Small Potatoes]]}}
The [[player]] with this card saved may use the units on any food small cards interchangeably ([[Radish]], [[Milk]], [[Cabbage]] or [[Water]]). The unit numbers remain the same, however they may be used for any type of food.
==Trivia==
* Protein resequencers, as featured in ''Star Trek: Enterprise'',<ref>[https://memory-alpha.fandom.com/wiki/Protein_resequencer Protein Resequencer at Memory-Alpha FANDOM Wiki]</ref> are devices that are capable of creating food.

==References==
* This card is the same as [[Protein Resequencer (Conquest)]] from the [[Violet Booster Deck (Conquest)|Violet Booster Deck]] for [[The Conquest of the Magic Carrot]]

[[Category:Star Trek]]

{{Quest Card|aggressive = Yes|type = Very Special|deck = Caramel Swirl|game = Quest|name = Beating A Dead Horse|image = 1140 - Beating A Dead Horse-thumbnail|cardid = 1140|dice = {{Dice|Brown}}|background = Diagonal Gradient|prev = [[Small Potatoes]]|next = [[Cherry Cordial]]}}
May be used once to force any [[opponent]] who has just lost a [[Bunny]] to roll the [[dice|brown die]] and to lose another bunny ([[player|player's]] choice) if the opponent rolls an Even number. Must be used during the turn in which the first bunny was killed!

==Trivia==
* The phrase 'beating a dead horse' (or 'flogging a dead horse') means to carry on talking about something after it has already been discussed or decided. It can also mean to waste time trying to do something that is impossible.

{{Quest Card|aggressive = Yes|type = Very Special|deck = Caramel Swirl|game = Quest|name = Southpaw|image = 1142 - Southpaw-thumbnail|cardid = 1142|background = Diagonal Gradient|prev = [[Cherry Cordial]]|next = [[You Go Girl]]}}
'''Southpaw''' may be used once by a left-handed player while the direction of play is counter-clockwise to immediately choose five Carrots from any Kaballa's Market. Or may be used immediately to eliminate [[Baseball Blues]] or [[Narcoleptic Dog]]. May be used at any time!
==Trivia==
* "Southpaw" is slang for left-hander.
* The bear in the infield appears on [[Bad News - Bears]].

{{Quest Card|aggressive = No|type = Very Special|deck = Caramel Swirl|game = Quest|name = You Go Girl|image = 1143 - You Go Girl-thumbnail|cardid = 1143|background = Diagonal Gradient|prev = [[Southpaw]]|next = [[Counter-Clock Warlock]]}}
May be used once by a female [[player]] to automatically take the next turn of play thereby skipping all of the player's turns in between. Play continues in the same direction as before. May be used between any two players' turns!
==Trivia==
* The origin of the popular 1990s cry of encouragement, "You go, girl!" is unclear. It was commonly used in the 1990s sitcom ''Martin'', but is probably older.

{{Quest Card|aggressive = No|type = Play Immediately|deck = Caramel Swirl|game = Quest|name = Counter-Clock Warlock|image = 1146 - Counter-Clock Warlock|cardid = 1146|background = Play Immediately Pattern|prev = [[You Go Girl]]|next = [[Smell That Shoe]]}}
All [[Bunny Modifier (Concept)|Bunny Modifier]] [[Card types|cards]] under [[Bunny|Bunnies]] in the [[Bunny Circle]] are moved to the next bunny counter-clockwise.
==Trivia==
* A warlock is traditionally defined simply as a man who practices witchcraft

{{Quest Card|aggressive = No|type = Run|deck=Pumpkin Spice|game = Quest|name =Against All Odds|image =1230 - Against All Odds-thumbnail|cardid=1230|dice={{dice|}}|background=|prev=[[Gumdrop Grievance]]|next =[[Banality]]}}

'''Against All Odds''' may be used once by a [[player]] to force all of his [[Opponent|opponents]] to [[discard]] any [[Card types|card]] in their five-card hand with an Odd [[Card Identification Number]]. Replacement cards are drawn [[Immediately (Concept)|immediately]].
==Trivia==
* The card parodies the 2007 film musical ''Sweeney Todd: the Demon Barber of Fleet Street''.<ref>[https://sweeneytodd.fandom.com/wiki/Main_Page The Sweeney Todd FANDOM Wiki]</ref> The card shows Johnny Depp in the title role, and a portrait of composer Stephen Sondheim appears in a picture frame in the background.
==References==

{{Quest Card|aggressive = Yes|type = Run|deck=Pumpkin Spice|game = Quest|name =Banality|image =1231 - Banality-thumbnail|cardid=1231|dice={{dice|}}|background=|prev=[[Against All Odds]]|next =[[Banjaxers]]}}
'''Banality''' may be used once by a [[player]] who has not used an [[Aggressive]] card against any [[opponent]] to choose three [[Carrots]].
==References==
* The gorilla on this card previously appeared on [[Text Time (Quest)]] and [[Text Time (LITE)]]
